title: FinancialPerspectiveTitles
description: Per-call schema for the financial perspective Round 1 (title list). Used by the decomposed strategy-map generation path. The per-call model only emits the array of titles; positional IDs (F1/F2/F3) are assigned by `_strategy_map_assembly.py`. Excludes `id` per Decision §2 of the optimize-strategy-map-latency design.
